description: Fertagus: GTFS transit data is a dataset listed in Mobility Database, a catalogue of GTFS and GTFS Realtime transit feeds, published or maintained by Fertagus. Public transport schedule data (routes, stops, trips and stop times in the General Transit Feed Specification) for Palmela, Setúbal, Portugal. Coverage: Palmela, Setúbal, Portugal. The Mobility Database lists 1 GTFS schedule feed for this provider (Palmela, Setúbal, Portugal). The schedule feeds declare these GTFS features: Bike Allowed, Continuous Stops, Fares V1, Feed Information, Headsigns, Location Types, Route Colors, Shapes. At least one feed is marked as published by the operator itself. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the Mobility Database listing (licence field empty). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, accessibility and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-mobility-database-mobilitydata. An ILU catalogue deposit supplies a separate 2019 Fertagus GTFS snapshot originally collected from the discontinued Transporlis service. It is a historical route to stops, routes, trips, schedules and geometry; it is not asserted identical to the current feed or valid for present service. The native agency-file boilerplate incorrectly names Lisbon Metro; provider identity follows the deposit title, creator and project metadata row, with file contents unverified.
